acceptanceCriteria: readiness and candidate refuse an attestation whose recorded argv differs from the policy gate argv, with a test in corvint-tasks.
The Corvint store runs on a corvint-tasks build that has the check.
body: Filed 2026-09-24 after the 0.8.0 release. Residual from V1-0208. A release gate attestation is accepted without checking that it was produced by the argv the policy declares for that gate (for example release-checklist with --pre-promotion under policyVersion 2). The change lands in the corvint-tasks repository; this store records the obligation.
title: corvint-tasks: release gate attestations are not checked against the policy gate argv
